reason: Static index attachment is supported; section-start ordering and float-pool placement are unproven.

evidence.why: Only index declaration and source expressions.

reason: 40-byte pool composition and nine emitted single-precision constants cannot be proved by source literals.

evidence.why: Copies arg1 verbatim and rejects registered players.

reason: Argument state is unchecked; allocation need not activate the entry, and duplicate requests do not refresh it.
Caller uses six magnifier entries, not four.

evidence.why: Request bounds ownership to 0..3; release lacks bound and active guard.

reason: Release is owner-match based regardless of active state, and normal caller can supply slots 4/5.
Initializer clears registration x24 and direction x28, not assignment x2C.
Release does not clear owner mapping x2C; clarify registration versus owner.
